items.title: Newmont (NEM) Could Be 19% Undervalued Following Its New Nevada Gold Deals
items.summary: Newmont (NEM) is back in focus after a series of Nevada deals, including a fresh earn-in on Headwater Gold’s Jupiter Project and a formalized joint venture at Spring Peak that deepen its exploration pipeline. See our latest analysis for Newmont. These Nevada agreements sit against a backdrop of a share price that has risen 20.52% over the past month and 12.81% year to date, while Newmont’s 1 year total shareholder return of 68.52% and 3 year total shareholder return above 200% point to strong...

items.title: Headwater Gold and Newmont sign earn-in agreement for Jupiter project
items.summary: The agreement allows Newmont to earn up to a 75% stake in Jupiter by spending $30m and providing a pre-feasibility study.
